name: EPIC 201480522
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 9.6 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201480522 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.633542 (16th-84th percentiles 9.168405-10.032464), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201480522 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.034208 (16th-84th percentiles 0.904505-1.147786), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201480522: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4599.9287 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201480522 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3430.898438 (16th-84th percentiles 3303.710938-3530.390625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.16 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,431 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.03 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,600 K at its surface.
